facts.text: Caroline attended a poetry reading on Friday, which was described as a transgender poetry reading where transgender individuals shared their stories through poetry.

evidence.quote: I went to a poetry reading last Fri - it was really powerful!
It was a transgender poetry reading where transgender people shared their stories through poetry.

facts.text: The poetry reading was characterized as a safe space for self-expression and empowering for participants to celebrate their identities.

evidence.quote: It was extra special 'cause it was a safe place for self-expression and it was really empowering to hear others share and celebrate their identities.
